_comment: compose-calendar job — create a calendar-program-template with INLINE day
components. Days are embedded in the payload, never separate records.
Every referenced program/omni-rom/survey must ALREADY EXIST (create it via its
own job first). The template lands as a DRAFT.
'_comment' is ignored by the runner — it reads only the keys below via plan.get().
env                     : MCP registration name; `--env` overrides it.
days[]                  : one entry per scheduled day —
activityType : enum survey | evaluation | exercise | omniRom | posture |
ref       : { type, documentId } — REQUIRED for the relation-gated types,
MUST BE OMITTED for evaluation / posture / bodyComposition (they gate no
relation). ref.type must match the activityType's target:

ref.documentId: <documentId — resolve via list_program-template at plan time>
<documentId — resolve via list_survey-template at plan time>
